notes:
Summary: Harborly is a mid-market contact center platform focused on SMBs in NA/EU. Exploring multilingual automation layer to power agent assist + automated summaries. They run support in 6 locales (EN-US, ES-MX, ES-ES, FR-FR, PT-BR, DE-DE) and require locale-appropriate tone (formal vs. casual) and legal residency options for EU customers.

POC recap (2-week):
- Ran 2-week POC on a dedicated GPU pool (Redwood Dedicated trial). Focus: Spanish + French quality, agent assist latency, and ticket summarization fidelity.
- Tools integrated: ticket creation via webhook (internal 'FlowDesk' tool), agent-side quick-reply templates, and live tool-calling to update ticket fields.
- Observations: intent extraction and summary length tuning good for 80% of cases; tone adaptation needs per-locale prompt templates.
- Perf: target p50 < 150ms for short-turn agent replies; measured p50 ~ 170ms on POC config during synthetic load. Peak spike test (4x baseline) reached 600 req/s sustained for 3 minutes; autoscaling warmed but tail latency increased.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need consistent tone by market — our Spanish CX should feel local, not translated." — Alejandra Ramos, Head of Support.
- AE notes: prospect cares deeply about predictable cost during holiday spikes; willing to accept small latency increase if cost is controlled.

Security / compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for specific customers. Legal requested DPA + audit log sampling.

Open items & blockers:
- Confirmation of residency options for EU tenants (Private vs Dedicated).
- Final SAML metadata — they use Azure AD and want test IdP prior to SOW.
- Cost model for 4x seasonal bursts (want clear floor/ceiling).

Next steps / near-term plan:
- Redwood to deliver tuned prompt bundle (locale-aware tone templates) + batching profile recommendations by 2026-03-10.
- Org legal to review DPA; redline expected 2026-03-15.
- Technical deep-dive with SE to run SAML test and second spike test against Dedicated config (scheduled 2026-03-08).

Artifacts: POC results (drive link), call transcripts (fireflies), GitHub snippets of integration hooks in shared drive.

Misc notes (shorthand):
- Priority: agent_assist > ticket_summarization > outbound templates.
- Interested in Optimize for cost suggestions (kv-prefix caching, batch sizing).
- Mentioned competitor eval vs Genesys + in-house ML routing.
- Happy path: sign 12-mo dedicated commit with burst window + optional private deployment for EU customers.
